runs.content: Inditex sits near its first-ever €60 close on H1 FY26 sales +9.2% at constant currency, as consumer discretionary leads the quarter and led today's risk-on rebound; the book's first BME name adds non-US, non-healthcare diversification, and PFE was trimmed for capacity at −2.18%.

Becton Dickinson is +36% in 3 months and held near its 6-month high through the AI-capex rout after an FQ4 beat (adj EPS +27%) and an FY27 adj EPS guide of $13.10–13.30 (~16x), a defensive non-tech medtech momentum entry; ICFI was exited as the capacity trim.
